name: Ambush Vine
appearance: A mass of long, thorny vines that can blend into surrounding vegetation.

powers.name: Lashing Vines
powers.damage: 2d8 + 6, with additional effects against immobilized enemies

Power details.name: Poison Lash
Power details.effectNote: Melee basic attack, reach 2 squares. Poison keyword.

Power details.name: Foot Snare
Power details.effectNote: Reach 4 squares. A hit knocks the target prone.

Power details.name: Lashing Vines
Power details.effectNote: Healing keyword. Close burst 4 against enemies. Each hit on an immobilized target deals an extra 1d8 damage and restores 5 HP to the vine.

Power details.name: Rapid Growth
Power details.effectNote: Encounter power. When first bloodied, the vine spawns two Ambush Vine Shoots within 4 squares. They act immediately after the vine on its initiative count.

Power details.name: Sprout Vine
Power details.effectNote: At-will minor action. The vine takes 10 damage and spawns one Ambush Vine Shoot within 4 squares. The shoot acts immediately after the vine on its initiative count.

Ambush Vine Shoot.name: Level 15 Minion Controller
Ambush Vine Shoot.effectNote: Medium fey beast (plant), 300 XP. Initiative +14, Perception +14, tremorsense 20, AC 29, Fortitude 27, Reflex 30, Will 23. Speed 6 squares and burrow 6. It has 1 HP and takes no damage from a missed attack.

Ambush Vine Shoot.name: Wrapping Vines
Ambush Vine Shoot.effectNote: Standard at-will melee basic attack, reach 2 squares. +20 vs. Fortitude. Hit for 12 damage and restrain the target (save ends).

Ambush Vine Shoot.name: Enwrap
Ambush Vine Shoot.effectNote: Enemies adjacent to the shoot take a −2 penalty to saving throws against immobilized and restrained.

Ambush Vine Shoot.name: Ability scores and Stealth
Ambush Vine Shoot.effectNote: Str 18, Dex 25, Con 16, Int 2, Wis 15, Cha 12. Stealth +19, or +24 in undergrowth, trees, or swamps. Unaligned. No languages.

notes: August 2012 update, p. 82, corrects the parent vine’s original 1,400 XP to 2,800 XP. The shoot’s 300 XP comes from its own block.
Unaligned. No languages. Saving throws +2 and one action point. Stealth rises from +20 to +25 in undergrowth, trees or swamp.
The vine stalks prey through canopy, soil and water. It can hide underground or blend with surrounding plants.
Source: Wizards of the Coast, Monster Manual 2 (4e), pp. 204–205, with the August 2012 Rules Update, p. 82.

name: Pseudodragon
appearance: A small winged drake with a fanged muzzle, clawed feet, and a stinging tail.

Power details.name: Sting
Power details.effectNote: Melee basic attack with the Poison keyword.

Power details.name: Flyby Attack
Power details.effectNote: At-will standard action. Fly up to 8 squares and make one melee basic attack along that route. Moving away from that target does not provoke its opportunity attacks.

Power details.name: Invisibility
Power details.effectNote: Standard action with the Illusion keyword. It recharges when the pseudodragon takes damage. Invisibility lasts while the pseudodragon stays still.

notes: August 2012 update, p. 77, changes the original size from Tiny to Small. The checked Deluxe page already shows Small.
Unaligned. No languages. It communicates with animal noises. Wild pseudodragons hunt other creatures and usually leave humanoids alone unless provoked. Some live with humanoids as pets.
The tactics use Sting during a Flyby Attack when it is available. Against a persistent enemy the pseudodragon shifts, then uses Invisibility.
Source: Wizards of the Coast, Monster Manual (4e Deluxe), pp. 90–92, with the August 2012 Rules Update, p. 77.
